title: CALCIUM FLUX AGONISTS AND METHODS THEREFOR
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of enhancing an immune response of an immunocompetent cell to a ligand of a pattern recognition receptor.SOLUTION: A method of enhancing an immune response of an immunocompetent cell to a ligand of a pattern recognition receptor comprises a step of contacting the immunocompetent cell with a calcium flux agonist. In the method, the calcium flux agonist is a Caionophore or a SERCA inhibitor. In the method, the Caionophore is ionomycin, calcimycin, Caionophore II, Caionophore IV, Caionophore V, or Caionophore VI.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
